cards.headline: CBN sets N15bn capital requirement for dollar stablecoins
cards.byline: Punch · Sat 7 Nov, 00:38 Lagos · latest of 2 reports from 1 outlet
cards.what_happened: The Central Bank of Nigeria has set a N15 billion capital requirement for dollar stablecoins, according to a Punch Newspapers headline. The article text provided contains only the headline, so further details on scope and implementation are not available.
timeline: Fri 6 Nov, 10:10 · Punch: “CBN sets N15bn capital requirement for dollar stablecoin issuers”

cards.headline: EFCC secures final forfeiture of $163,592 proceeds of US fraud
cards.what_happened: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has secured a final forfeiture of $163,592 linked to proceeds of fraud committed in the United States. The forfeiture was reported by Premium Times Nigeria. No further details on parties or timing are provided in the available text.
key_facts: EFCC secured a final forfeiture of $163,592.
analysis: Court outcome as reported by Premium Times; AURA has not checked court records.

cards.headline: FG vows National Library project completion in 24 months
cards.what_happened: The Federal Government, through Minister of Education Tunji Alausa, has pledged to complete the long-abandoned National Library of Nigeria headquarters project in Abuja within 24 months. The commitment was made publicly, though the article excerpt provided does not give contractor or cost details. The project is a public works undertaking of the Federal Ministry of Education.
key_facts: Tunji Alausa is the Minister of Education.
The National Library of Nigeria headquarters project in Abuja had been long abandoned.

cards.headline: EFCC secures conviction of 10 over illegal petroleum dealings in Delta
cards.what_happened: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) secured the conviction of 10 people over illegal petroleum dealings in Delta State.
key_facts: The EFCC secured the conviction of 10 people over illegal petroleum dealings in Delta State.

cards.headline: Mbah inaugurates 68 development centre administrators to take projects, policies to more communities
cards.what_happened: Enugu State Governor Peter Mbah has inaugurated 68 development centre administrators tasked with carrying projects and policies to more communities. The appointments are aimed at extending government programmes to grassroots areas. The article text provided is limited to the headline.

also.text: The Transmission Company of Nigeria (TCN) has rejected an claim by Ikeja Electric (IKEDC) regarding the cause of recent power outages.
